scripts.deploy: echo ${BRANCH:-national} && pnpm run gen-events && pnpm run styles-build && zola --config "${BRANCH:-national}.zola.toml" build && head -6 public/index.html && cargo install worker-build ; wrangler deploy --config "${BRANCH:-national}.wrangler.toml"
scripts.dev: pnpm run gen-events && pnpm run styles-build && zola --config "local.${BRANCH:-national}.zola.toml" build --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1111  && cargo install --locked worker-build ; wrangler dev --local
